name: Puebla Open 2009

information: Competition starts at 9:00 AM. Registration until May 20th is $200.00 pesos for 3 events or less, and $250.00 for 4 or more. After that day the registration is $250.00 pesos for 3 events or less, $300.00 for 4 or more. The day of the competition the cost will be $300 for 3 events or less, $350.00 for 4 or more.
